body: System-wide Dictation on Apple devices runs entirely on-device, and the speech it transcribes reaches the foundation model through a tokenizer: an encoder that maps short windows of waveform onto the representation the language model reads. Because that model is sparsely activated under Instruction-Following Pruning, only a small subset of its experts occupies DRAM at any time, so the always-on tokenizer competes for the same memory, and its parameter count bears directly on power and latency. In this work we study how to compress such a tokenizer by distillation, taking as the supervision…
summaryZh: 苹果发布研究，探讨如何通过蒸馏技术压缩端侧语音识别系统的Tokenizer。由于端侧大模型采用稀疏激活架构，Tokenizer需与模型权重竞争有限的DRAM资源，该研究旨在通过压缩Tokenizer参数量，降低功耗并提升响应速度，对端侧AI部署具有参考价值。
